title: Configparser.SafeConfigParser has been removed
summary: Python 3.12 removed configparser.SafeConfigParser, so using it raises an error.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of configparser.SafeConfigParser with configparser.ConfigParser.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
